lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
forms-main: 6,176 B beyond the first copy, p-queue 4,026 B, p-timeout 958 B, debounce 949 B.
forms-submit: 6,176 B beyond the first copy, p-queue 4,026 B, p-timeout 958 B, debounce 949 B.
forms-settings: 67 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/vue 54 B, vue-demi 13 B.
All 4 pages load the same 2 files: 556,215 B raw, 137,284 B gzip, 94.0 % of the smallest page (forms-emptyContent, 591,621 B).
Inside: @nextcloud/vue 395,621 B, vue 74,981 B, vue-router 29,543 B, dompurify 22,495 B, semver 9,041 B.
css holds 4 stylesheets, 403,767 B, and no page of this build loads any of them: no entry in js is named after one, and none is reached from an entry that is.

Loaded from PHP: embedded.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php), forms-style.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php), forms.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php), public.css (lib/Controller/PageController.php).
Each is loaded from PHP or built into the bundle, so none is left without a loader. Where the build writes its stylesheets somewhere else, --css=DIR names that directory.
moment, 292,774 B on the forms-main page: carries its locale data; luxon and date-fns are a fraction of it.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,400 B on the forms-main page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (79 packages, 675 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
